what: [parity] Live donchian legs evaluate the FORMING bar; the backtest scores the CLOSED bar. A breakout whose confidence clears min_confidence only on the final close is never seen live. MEASURED 2026-09-30 by replaying trend_donchian.order_package() over /api/bot/candles XRPUSDT 4h: the 2026-09-15 16:00Z bar closes as a short breakout at conf 0.8325, which clears trend_donchian_xrp_4h's min_confidence 0.8, and the leg is short-only. Live audit for 15:50-20:10Z: 90 'no breakout' rows and 43 'confidence X below min_confidence 0.8' rows, max 0.7734. At 20:04Z the channel had rolled to [1.2886, 1.4916] and the setup was gone. That is one missed real-money short on bybit_2/bybit_portfolio. n=1 so far, and the replay has not been run across the other donchian legs.
why_it_matters: If this recurs, the live fill rate of confidence-gated donchian legs is below the backtest's, and Gate 1/2 read a signal set the live book cannot take.
